scope: The reported touch-selection autoscroll failure in a full-screen scroll view without a SafeArea inset. Permit geometry or lifecycle changes justified by evidence.

checks.expectation: Long-press selection followed by dragging towards either screen edge scrolls the full-screen viewport in the expected direction without requiring an unreachable outside-screen pointer location.
checks.evidence: Use the frozen reproduction to validate a focused interaction test; verify selection as well as scroll offset. Run against unfixed and submitted source.

checks.expectation: Existing outside-viewport dragging and relevant mouse/handle selection behavior remain correct.
checks.evidence: Run existing scrollable selection tests and inspect changed assertions. Do not require a particular edge-band algorithm or line-height query.

checks.expectation: Scrolling stabilizes after the selection gesture ends, while valid continuous dragging still progresses.
checks.evidence: Assert eventual stable offset after release and progress during the relevant drag sequence. Do not require immediate zero movement if a supported animation is completing.

checks.expectation: Relevant axis directions, small viewports, and coordinate transforms preserve valid selection and scrolling.
checks.evidence: Inspect the affected contract and run focused boundary tests appropriate to the change; distinguish supported absent state and sentinels from invalid inputs.

checks.expectation: Regression coverage fails for the reported behavior on unfixed source and passes after the change.
checks.evidence: Cite test names, commands, expected behavioral failure, and fixed results. Setup and compilation errors do not establish reproduction.

checks.expectation: The fix is complete at affected layers, respects the applicable freeze, and avoids unnecessary companion changes.
checks.evidence: Inspect implementation and caller coverage. If companion changes are necessary, verify their tests and complete patches against the pinned source. Otherwise document why core coverage is sufficient.
